DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の用紙でお困りのところがあれば、お聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me if any part of the transfer form is giving you trouble.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込みたいのですが、もらったメモの支店番号が薄くて、一なのか七なのか読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の振込先メモの支店番号が薄く、一か七か読み取れないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to transfer my rent, but the branch number on the note I received is faint. I can't tell whether it is one or seven.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the branch number on the rent-transfer note is faint and you cannot distinguish one from seven. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 推測で入力せず、元の案内を出した方へ確かめる必要があります。ほかの情報は照合できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't enter a guess; you need to check with whoever issued the original instructions. Have you matched the other details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座の名義も、請求書には会社名、メモには人の名前が書かれています。同じ振込先か自分では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求書は会社名でメモは個人名のため、同じ口座か判断できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The account holder is a company on the invoice but a person's name on the note. I cannot judge for myself whether they are the same transfer destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the invoice has a company name and the note an individual's name, so you cannot tell whether it is the same account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いも、支払先として確認できている連絡先へお尋ねください。今日は実行せず、必要な情報を整理しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask about that difference too, using contact details verified as belonging to the payee. Shall we leave the transfer undone today and organize what you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は送金しません。管理会社へ支店番号と口座名義を確かめますが、手数料の見方だけ先に教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は送金せず管理会社に番号と名義を確認すると決め、手数料の見方だけ先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't send money today. I'll check the branch number and account name with the management company, but could you first show me how to check the fee?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to transfer today and to verify the number and name with the management company; ask only how to check the fee first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用方法と振込先が決まってから、実行前の画面などで手数料を確認します。振込額と手数料は分けてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After deciding the method and recipient, check the fee on the screen before execution, for example. Look at the transfer amount and fee separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家賃の金額から手数料を引くのではなく、振込額とは別に支払いが必要かを確認する、ということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家賃から手数料を差し引くと決めず、振込額と別の支払いの有無を確認する理解を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I shouldn't simply deduct the fee from the rent; I should check whether it must be paid separately from the amount transferred.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your understanding that you should check for separate payment rather than deciding to subtract the fee from the rent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 負担する条件は請求元の案内もご確認ください。金額と手数料を含む出金の合計を、実行前に読み分けていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Also check the biller's instructions on who pays the fee. Before execution, distinguish the transfer amount from the total withdrawal including the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 請求元に手数料の負担も尋ねます。確認した振込先と金額を書き直してから、改めて相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手数料負担も請求元に尋ね、確認した口座と金額をメモし直して再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the biller who bears the fee too. I'll rewrite the verified destination and amount in my note, then come back for another consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the biller about fee responsibility, rewrite the verified account and amount, and return for consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日は振込を進めず、お手元のメモをお返しします。確認できた案内をお持ちになったら、内容の照合から続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we won't proceed with the transfer today. I'll return your note. When you bring verified instructions, we'll resume by matching the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごの商品は、まとめてお会計でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I ring up all the goods in your basket together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の文具と自分の食品を一緒に入れてしまいました。会社の分だけ領収書が必要なので、会計を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社用文具と自分用食品を混ぜたと説明し、会社分だけ領収書を出すため別会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I mixed office stationery with my own food. I need a receipt only for the company's part, so please separate the transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain mixing company stationery and personal food and request separate transactions for a company-only receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文具を先に分けますね。お持ち帰りの袋も、それぞれ別に必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll separate the stationery first. Do you need separate carry bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食品は持っている袋に入れます。文具用には袋を一枚買いたいので、袋代を先に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品は自分の袋に入れ、文具用の袋一枚を買う前に袋代を見せてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The food will go in my own bag. I'd like to buy one bag for the stationery, so please show me the bag price first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you'll use your own food bag and ask to see the price before buying one stationery bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋代はこちらの表示です。文具の会計に加えてよろしいですか。お支払いの方法も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bag price is displayed here. May I add it to the stationery transaction? How will you pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その袋代は文具のほうに入れてください。文具はカード、食品は現金で払うつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋代を文具会計に含め、文具はカード、食品は現金で支払うと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please include that bag cost with the stationery. I plan to pay by card for the stationery and cash for the food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify including the bag with stationery, paying for stationery by card and food in cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 文具と袋をカードで先にお支払いですね。領収書の宛名と品目の書き方について、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, stationery and the bag by card. Any preference for the receipt's addressee and item description?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛名は勤務先の名前で、品目は文具代にしてください。食品を含めない内容か、支払う前に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名を勤務先名、品目を文具代と希望し、食品を含まない明細を支払前に確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Use my employer's name as addressee and stationery expenses as the description. Before paying, I'd like to check that the details exclude food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request your employer's name and stationery expenses on the receipt and ask to check the food-free details before payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この文具と袋だけの明細をご確認ください。食品のお支払いは、こちらの会計が終わってから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check this statement containing only the stationery and bag. We'll ask for payment for the food after this transaction finishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 文具と袋だけになっています。まずこの分をカードで払い、食品の合計はその後で聞かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文具と袋だけの明細を確認し、その分を先にカードで払い食品の合計は後で聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It has only stationery and the bag. I'll first pay for these by card; please tell me the food total afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the stationery-and-bag-only statement, pay that part by card first and request the food total afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。最初のお支払いを済ませ、領収書をお渡ししてから、食品の会計へ進みます。文具はこのかごに分けておきますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We'll complete the first payment and give you the receipt, then handle the food. I'll keep the stationery separate in this basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 少し雨が降ってきましたね。園内の行き先をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's started raining a little. Shall I help you choose somewhere in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が来るまで四十分ほどあるので散歩するつもりでしたが、傘を持っていません。近くで休める所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人到着まで四十分で散歩予定だったが傘がないと説明し、近くで休める場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to walk with about forty minutes until my friend arrives, but I have no umbrella. Is there somewhere nearby to rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain planning a walk with forty minutes until your friend arrives but having no umbrella; ask for a nearby rest place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図の案内棟には屋内の休憩室があります。席が空いているかは、行ってみないと分かりません。待ち合わせはそちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The information building on this map has an indoor rest room. We won't know whether seats are available until you go. Is that your meeting point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待ち合わせは時計のある門です。休憩室へ行く前に、友人へ場所を変えられるか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待ち合わせは時計のある門だと答え、休憩室へ移る前に友人へ場所変更を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're meeting at the gate with a clock. Before moving to the rest room, I'll ask my friend whether we can change the meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you are meeting at the clock gate and will ask your friend about changing it before going to the rest room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 門と案内棟は、この図では別の位置です。お友達とは、どちらで待ち合わせることになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The gate and information building are separate places on this map. Which have you agreed to meet at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は時計のある門まで来るそうなので、待ち合わせは変えません。休憩した後、その門へ戻る道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は時計の門へ来るため待ち合わせを変えず、休憩室から門に戻る道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend says they'll come to the clock gate, so the meeting place won't change. I'd like the way back to that gate after resting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the clock-gate meeting since your friend is coming there and ask the way back from the rest room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内棟から門への通路はこの線です。園内を一周しなくても戻れます。雨の中で長く歩く予定は見直されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This line is the passage from the information building to the gate. You can return without circling the park. Will you reconsider walking far in the rain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一周はやめて、案内棟で休むだけにします。門へ戻る時間も必要なので、そこでずっと待たないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周回をやめて案内棟で休み、門へ戻る時間を考えて長居しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give up the circuit and just rest in the information building. I need time to return to the gate, so I won't stay there the whole time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide against the circuit and to rest in the information building without staying too long, allowing time back to the gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、案内棟の表示と、戻る門の時計を目印になさってください。休憩室に空席がなければ、職員へ状況をお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Use the information-building signs and the clock at the return gate as landmarks. If no seats are free in the rest room, ask staff about the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空いていると決めつけずに職員に尋ねます。友人にも、休憩してから約束の門へ戻ると伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空席を当然とせず職員に尋ね、休憩後に元の約束の門へ戻ることも友人へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume there are free seats; I'll ask staff. I'll also tell my friend that I'll rest and then return to our agreed gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask staff without assuming seats are free and tell your friend you will return to the original gate after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、待ち合わせ場所はそのままと伝えておくと行き違いを避けやすいですね。園内図をお持ちください。足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, telling them the meeting place is unchanged helps avoid missing each other. Take the park map. Watch your footing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れの表示をご覧になっていましたね。どの列車についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the delay display. Which train are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この表示の列車です。仕事の打合せに向かうので、到着がどのくらい遅くなるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示の列車で仕事の打合せへ向かい、到着への影響を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This train on the display. I'm heading to a work meeting and want to know how much later I'll arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are taking the displayed train to a work meeting and want to know the effect on arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、表示されているのは現時点の遅れです。打合せの開始時刻は、もうお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The displayed delay is the current delay. Has your meeting start time been fixed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開始は決まっています。ここに書かれた遅れを元の到着時刻に足して、相手に伝えようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始時刻が決まっており、表示の遅れを元の到着時刻に足して相手へ伝えるつもりだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The start time is fixed. I was going to add the displayed delay to the original arrival time and tell the other party.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the start time is fixed and you intended to add the displayed delay to the original arrival time when notifying them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その計算どおりに着くとは、まだご案内できません。途中の状況で遅れが変わる可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot yet say you'll arrive according to that calculation. The delay may change with conditions along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、到着時刻は断定せずに連絡します。動き始めているのか、それともまだ待つ状態なのかは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着を断定せず連絡する方針を述べ、既に動いているかまだ待つ状態か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll contact them without stating a definite arrival time. Do you know whether it has started moving or is still waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll contact them without a definite arrival and ask whether the train is moving or still waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示では発車時刻は未定となっています。運転の見通しについては、次の案内をお待ちいただく状況です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This display says departure time is undetermined. For the service outlook, we're currently waiting for the next announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 発車も未定なのですね。相手には先に打合せを始めてもらい、私は後から参加できるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発車未定を理解し、打合せを先に始めて後から参加できるか相手に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So departure is also undetermined. I'll ask them to start the meeting first and whether I can join later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge undetermined departure and say you'll ask about starting the meeting without you and joining later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでしたら、連絡してから案内の更新をご確認ください。列車を利用するかどうかは、その情報を見てお考えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then contact them and check for updated announcements. You can decide whether to take the train after seeing that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に始めてもらえると返事が来ました。今は到着を約束せず、次の案内を見て移動を判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に始めてもらう返信を伝え、到着は約束せず次の案内で移動を判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: They replied that they can start first. I won't promise an arrival now; I'll decide how to travel after the next announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the reply agreeing to start first and say you won't promise arrival but will decide travel from the next announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お相手と連絡が取れてよかったです。運行について新しい案内が出た際は、内容をご確認ください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you reached them. When new service information is issued, check its contents. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知についてのご相談ですね。どの部分が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're consulting about the notice you brought. Which part concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「相談のご案内」とありますが、何かを払うように言われているのでしょうか。難しくて、内容を取り違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談の案内を支払いの指示と読み違えていないか心配だと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 'consultation information,' but does that mean I'm being told to pay something? It's difficult, and I'm afraid of misunderstanding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you are misreading consultation information as a payment instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表題だけでは、支払いが必要とは判断できません。通知の差出し担当と、本文を一緒に見てもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The title alone doesn't tell us payment is required. May we look at the sending department and the body together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ここが差出し担当です。本文のこの段落を説明してもらう時間を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出し担当を示し、本文の特定の段落について説明を受ける時間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Here is the sending department. I'd like time to have this paragraph in the body explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the sending department and request time for an explanation of a particular paragraph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に相談の受け方を確認しましょう。説明を受ける際、言葉の面で希望することはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the department how to get a consultation. Do you have language preferences for the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語で説明を受けられるか知りたいです。難しい言葉は、文字でも見せてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベトナム語の説明が可能か尋ね、難しい語句は文字でも示してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to know whether I can get an explanation in Vietnamese. I'd also like difficult words shown in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether Vietnamese explanations are possible and request difficult terms in writing too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言語支援と書いて説明する希望を伝えます。ご都合の悪い時間帯も、担当へ知らせておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on your requests for language support and written explanations. Shall I also tell them times that don't suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平日の昼間は仕事です。夕方に相談できる候補があるか、予約方法と一緒に聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 平日昼は仕事であると伝え、夕方の候補と予約方法を担当へ聞いてほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I work during weekday daytime. Could you ask about evening options and how to book?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain weekday daytime work and request asking the department about evening possibilities and booking methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 夕方の希望も添えて確認します。ただし、今は日時も言語支援も確定していません。回答を受けてから相談日を決める流れでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll include your evening preference. But neither the time nor language support is confirmed yet. Shall we decide the day after receiving their answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、回答をいただいてから日を決めます。予約はまだなのですね。通知は手元に残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答後に日を決め、現時点では予約未成立だと確認して通知を保管すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll decide the day after their reply. There isn't a booking yet, right? I'll keep the notice with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll decide after the reply, confirm no booking exists yet and keep the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当への確認事項を整理してお渡しします。回答前の希望と、決まった内容を分けてご確認ください。本日のご案内は以上です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll organize and give you the questions for the department. Distinguish requests before their answer from confirmed details. That concludes today's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はお済みですね。書類について、確認したいことがございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've finished paying. Is there anything you want to check about documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場から休んだ期間が分かる書類を頼まれました。この領収書を出せばよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場が休んだ期間の分かる書類を求めており、領収書でよいと思っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace asked for a document showing the period I was absent. I think I can submit this receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your workplace wants a document showing your absence period and you think the receipt is suitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書の日付は今日ですが、お休みになった期間と同じとは限りません。職場から指定の用紙や、書いてほしい項目は示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The receipt is dated today, which may not match your absence period. Did your workplace provide a form or specify required details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用紙はありません。「休んだ期間が分かるもの」としか聞いていないので、今日の日付だけで足りるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定用紙はなく期間が分かるものとしか聞いておらず、受診日だけで足りるか不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No form. They only said something showing the period I was absent, so I don't know whether today's date alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no form was specified and only proof of the absence period was requested, so the visit date alone may not suffice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何を証明する必要があるか、提出先に確かめると相談しやすくなります。病名などの記載も求められているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Checking with the recipient what needs proving makes consultation easier. Are they requesting the illness name or similar details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこまでは言われていません。病名も全部書いてもらえば安心だと思いましたが、必要な項目を先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 病名の記載は求められていないと述べ、全て追加する前に必要項目を職場へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: They haven't said that. I thought having the illness name and everything written would be reassuring, but I'll first ask what details are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say an illness name hasn't been requested and you'll ask your workplace for required details before adding everything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載内容はご自身だけで決めず、確認した内容を文書の担当へお伝えください。申請する書類は、まだ決めずにおきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't decide the contents alone; tell the document staff what you verified. Shall we leave which document to apply for undecided?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今は申請しません。職場には、必要な期間と記載項目、それに提出用の用紙があるかを尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今は申請せず、必要な期間・記載項目・指定用紙の有無を職場へ尋ねると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I won't apply now. I'll ask my workplace about the period required, the details and whether there's a submission form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to apply now and to ask your workplace about the required period, information and any designated form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に、その回答を持って文書担当へご相談ください。発行できる内容や費用、受取りの見通しも担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, bring their answer to the document staff. They'll check what can be issued, costs and likely collection timing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書はなくさず保管します。回答を持って相談する時に、申請前に費用と受取り時期も伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を保管し、提出先の回答と共に再相談して申請前に費用と受取り時期を尋ねたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the receipt safely. When consulting with their reply, I'd like to ask about cost and collection timing before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep the receipt and return with the recipient's answer, asking cost and collection timing before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにご相談ください。今日は領収書をお持ち帰りいただき、書類の申請は確認後ですね。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do so. Today, take the receipt home; document application comes after confirmation. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物について伺います。どのような物をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll ask about your lost item. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い長財布です。買い物の途中でないことに気づきましたが、落とした場所までは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い長財布を買い物中に紛失したが、落とした場所は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A blue long wallet. I noticed it missing while shopping, but I don't know where I dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost a blue long wallet while shopping but do not know where it fell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 気づいた場所と落とした場所は、分けて記録しましょう。最後に財布を手に取ったのはどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's separately record where you noticed and where it was lost. Where did you last take the wallet in hand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 文房具を買った店で会計をした時です。その後、袋の中を整理したので、店で落としたとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文房具店の会計が最後の使用で、その後袋を整理したため店で落としたとは断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: When paying at the shop where I bought stationery. I arranged my bag afterward, so I can't say I dropped it at that shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain last using it at the stationery shop's checkout, but arranging your bag afterward means you can't assert you lost it there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に使ったのはそのお店ですね。似た色の財布と区別できる特徴も教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So that shop was the last use. Can you describe features distinguishing it from similar-colored wallets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外側には飾りがありません。内側の小銭入れに、赤い糸で縫い直した所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飾りのない外見に加え、小銭入れの内側に赤い糸の縫い直しがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The outside has no decoration. Inside the coin pocket, there's a part resewn with red thread.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the undecorated outside and red-thread repair inside the coin pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内側の赤い縫い跡ですね。中にはカード類も入っていましたか。番号をここで読み上げる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The red stitching inside. Were there cards in it too? You needn't read out their numbers here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行のカードが一枚入っています。番号は控えていませんが、発行元は分かるので、そちらにも紛失を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行カード一枚が入り番号は不明だが発行元は分かり、そちらにも紛失を連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: One bank card. I haven't recorded its number, but I know the issuer, so I'll report the loss there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there is one bank card, its number is unknown but issuer known, and you'll report the loss there too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発行元への連絡と、こちらの紛失相談は別に進めてください。見つかった場合の連絡先を伺いますが、日中もお電話に出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Contacting the issuer and this lost-item consultation should proceed separately. For contact if found, can you answer calls during the day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕事中は出られないことがあります。連絡できる番号と、折り返せる時間をこちらに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕事中は電話に出られない場合があるため、連絡番号と折り返せる時間を書くと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I sometimes can't answer while working. I'll write a contact number and the times I can call back here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Offer to write a phone number and callback times because you may be unable to answer at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先と分かっている特徴を、この内容で確認していきます。発行元への連絡もお忘れなく。それでは、届出内容の確認へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll verify the contact details and known features from this information. Don't forget the issuer. Now please proceed to check the report contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。どの欄を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Which field do you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日付が過ぎてしまいました。もう受け取れないのかと思って、票を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の日付が過ぎており、もう受け取れないか心配だと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This date has passed. I brought the notice because I was worried I could no longer receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can still receive the parcel because a date on the notice has passed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご覧の欄には配達した日と書かれています。保管期限の欄は、その下に別にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The field you're looking at says delivery date. The storage-deadline field is separate, below it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達日を期限と思っていました。下の欄を確認したいです。日中は仕事なので、家族に頼むことも考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達日を期限と思っていたと認め、保管期限を確認し日中不在で家族の受取も考えていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I mistook the delivery date for the deadline. I'd like to check the lower field. I work daytime, so I'm considering asking family to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit mistaking delivery date for the deadline, check the storage deadline and mention considering family collection because you're away daytime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名宛人はどなたですか。代理の方に頼む場合も、荷物に応じた条件の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Who is it addressed to? Even for a representative, you must check the parcel-specific conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛名は私です。ただ、家族が受け取れる日もまだ決まっていないので、先に私が窓口へ行けるか調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名は自分で家族の予定も未定なので、まず本人が窓口に行けるか調べたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Me. But my family's available day isn't fixed either, so I'd first like to see whether I can go to the counter myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is addressed to you and family availability is undecided, so first you'll check whether you can visit the counter yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 票に書かれた問合せ先へ、ご本人が受け取りたい旨をお伝えください。どの時間帯を希望するとお伝えしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the inquiry point on the notice you want to collect personally. Which time period would you like to request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事が終わってからを希望します。受け取れる窓口と受付時間、それに私が持参する物を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事後の受取を希望し、受取窓口・受付時間・本人の持参物を問合せ先に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: After work. I'd like to ask about the collection counter, opening hours and what I must bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request after-work collection and ask the contact about counter, hours and items to bring yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その三点と保管期限を、票の番号を示して確認なさってください。ここではまだ受取日時の確定はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check those three points and the storage deadline using the notice number. The collection date and time have not been confirmed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この票を見ながら問い合わせます。窓口と時間が決まるまでは、家族にも受取りを頼まずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不在票を使って問い合わせ、窓口と時間が決まるまでは家族への依頼を保留すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll inquire while looking at this notice. Until the counter and time are settled, I won't ask family to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to inquire using the notice and hold off asking family until the counter and time are settled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望と確認事項は整理できましたね。不在票はこちらです。回答で日時と持ち物を確かめてからお出掛けください。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your wishes and questions are organized. Here is the notice. Check the date, time and required items in the reply before leaving. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードに関するお急ぎのご相談でしょうか。今の状況をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this an urgent card query? Tell me the current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外出用の袋にキャッシュカードがありません。家にあるかも分からないので、利用停止を相談したくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外出用の袋にカードがなく家にあるかも不明なため、利用停止を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My cash card isn't in my going-out bag. I don't know whether it's at home, so I came to ask about blocking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the card is missing from your outing bag and may or may not be home, so you'd like to discuss blocking it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紛失のご相談として担当につなぎます。カードの番号以外で、お持ちの口座資料はありますか。暗証番号はお話しにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll connect you to the loss-report staff. Do you have account documents besides the card number? Don't tell us your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号の控えはありませんが、通帳は持っています。暗証番号は言わずに、この通帳を担当の方にお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード番号の控えはないが通帳を持参し、暗証番号は言わず担当へ資料を示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have no recorded number, but I brought my bankbook. I'll show it to the staff without saying the PIN.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you lack a recorded card number but brought the bankbook, and will show the staff without disclosing your PIN. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停止が完了したかどうかも、担当が確認してご説明します。こちらで少々お待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will also check and explain whether blocking is complete. Could you wait here briefly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待っている間に家族から連絡が来ました。家の引き出しでカードを見つけたそうです。これなら、そのまま使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待つ間に家族が引き出しでカードを見つけたとの連絡を受け、そのまま使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: While waiting, family contacted me. They found the card in a drawer at home. Can I just use it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say family reported finding the card in a drawer while you waited, and ask whether it can simply be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つかったという連絡だけで利用できるとは判断できません。紛失相談の途中で見つかったことを、担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Finding it alone doesn't establish that you can use it. I'll tell the staff it was found during the loss consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族にはカードを保管してもらい、手続きの状態が分かるまでは使わないことにします。停止の手続きがどこまで進んでいるか、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族にはカードを保管してもらい、状態が分かるまで使用せず、停止手続きの進み具合を先に確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have family keep the card and won't use it until I know the procedural status. I'd like to first check how far blocking has progressed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say family will keep the card, you won't use it before knowing the status, and you want to check blocking progress first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。担当が現在の状態を確認し、見つかったカードの扱いを説明します。再発行についても、今は決めずにおきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Staff will check the current status and explain how to handle the found card. Let's leave reissue undecided for now too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかったから相談を取り消せばよい、とは考えずに説明を受けます。再発行を申し込む前に、今のカードの扱いを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見だけで相談取消と判断せず、再発行前に見つかったカードの扱いを担当へ聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume finding it means I can cancel the consultation; I'll hear the explanation. Before applying for reissue, I'll ask how to handle this card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't assume finding it cancels the consultation, and will ask staff how to handle it before seeking reissue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。カードが見つかった連絡と、手続き途中である点を併せてお伝えしますので、こちらでご相談をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your request, including that the card was found and procedures are underway. Please continue consulting here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: サービス窓口です。お持ちの商品について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the service counter. What would you like to discuss about the product you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで買ったノートを開いたら、途中のページ番号が飛んでいました。授業で使うつもりでしたが、まだ書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入ノートのページ番号が途中で飛び、授業用だが未記入だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened the notebook I bought here, the page numbers skipped in the middle. I intended it for class but haven't written in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the bought notebook's page numbers skip; it is for class but remains unwritten. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 抜けていると思われる所を、現物で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show us the apparently missing part in the actual notebook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここが十二ページで、次が十七ページです。間の紙がないように見えます。無理に引っ張ったりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十二ページの次が十七ページで間の紙がないように見え、無理に引いていないと現物を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is page twelve and the next is seventeen. There seem to be no sheets between them. I haven't pulled it forcefully or anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show page twelve followed by seventeen, explaining sheets seem absent and you haven't pulled forcefully. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ページの並びと綴じてある部分を確認します。購入時のレシートや、外側の袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the page sequence and binding. Do you have the purchase receipt or outer bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートはこちらです。外の袋は捨てましたが、表紙も中もこの状態で、書き込みはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートを示し、外袋は捨てたが現物に書き込みはないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the receipt. I threw away the outer bag, but the cover and inside are as you see, with no writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and say the outer bag was discarded but the notebook has no writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: レシートと現物を一緒に確認します。対応は確認後のご案内になりますが、ご希望は交換でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the receipt with the item. We'll advise what we can do after checking; would you prefer an exchange?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ罫線のノートに交換できれば助かります。授業でそろえて使いたいので、別の種類は今は選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 授業でそろえて使うため同じ罫線の商品との交換を希望し、別種類は選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: An exchange for the same ruling would help. I want to use the same type as the class, so I'm not choosing another kind now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request an exchange for the same ruling to match class use, declining to choose another type now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ種類の在庫と、今回の状態での対応を担当に確認します。まだ交換が決まったわけではありませんので、結果をお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the staff about stock of the same type and what they can do for this condition. Exchange isn't confirmed; could you wait for the result?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 交換できるかの回答を待ちます。このノートとレシートを見て、ページが抜けている所を担当の方にも確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換可否の回答を待ち、現物とレシートを使って担当にも欠落箇所を確認してほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for whether exchange is possible. I'd like the staff to inspect the missing part too using this notebook and receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Await the exchange decision and ask staff to verify the missing section using the item and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。現物の該当箇所とご希望を担当へ渡し、確認した結果をご案内します。こちらの待合席でお待ちください。
